verdict.rationale: Ramp ships automations (approval routing, AI agents, CLI scripted workflows), so versioning and rollback is a fair question for it. The evidence never documents version history, change review, or rollback for those automation definitions. The audit log records agent actions, the sandbox isolates testing from production, and a workflows:read scope appears in the MCP metadata. These are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback of automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
